source.check: returned unopposed: the Herald reports only one contest in the county, at Newtownbutler, and prints the nominations for every other division, each with a single candidate (Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1949)

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Thursday 2 June 1949 (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949: polling 'yesterday' for county and rural councils in Northern Ireland). The only county council contest was Newtownbutler; the Fermanagh Herald of 21 May 1949 reports that only one candidate was nominated in each of the other nineteen divisions and prints the whole nomination list, so all twenty members are recorded. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. Returned unopposed.
